title: First Launch
subtitle: Complete the initial setup when opening TaraHive for the first time.

blocks.text: After installing TaraHive and signing in, the application will guide you through a short setup process to configure permissions and personalize your experience.
TaraHive may request permission to access certain features on your device. These permissions enable the application's core functionality.

items: Location – Used for maps, navigation, nearby places, and weather updates.
Notifications – Allows TaraHive to send reminders, itinerary alerts, and important updates.
Camera – Required when uploading profile pictures or trip photos.
Storage – Allows importing and exporting itinerary files and saving downloaded content.

blocks.text: You can change these permissions later from your device's Settings menu.
During the initial setup, you may customize several application preferences to personalize your experience.

items: Choose between Light Mode and Dark Mode.
Review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

blocks.text: Once the setup is complete, TaraHive synchronizes your account information, preferences, and saved itineraries with the cloud so they are available across your devices.
The initial synchronization may take a few moments depending on your internet connection.

After synchronization is complete, you will be taken to the TaraHive dashboard. This is your starting point for creating itineraries, accessing upcoming trips, viewing AI recommendations, checking the weather, and managing your account.
Your TaraHive setup is now complete. You can begin creating your first itinerary, invite other travelers, and explore the application's travel planning features.
If you skipped any optional setup steps, they can be configured later from the Settings page.
